title: Vegan Greek Salad Wrap
description: A refreshing wrap filled with a variety of vegetables and served with a tangy tzatziki sauce.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Slice the cucumber, tomato, red onion, and bell pepper.
Grill the pita bread for 2-3 minutes, until it's lightly toasted.
Assemble the wrap by spreading the mayonnaise on the pita bread, then adding the sliced vegetables.
Drizzle the tzatziki sauce on top of the vegetables.
Fold the pita bread in half to enclose the filling.
Cut the wrap in half and serve immediately.
